title: The Novena to Our Lady of the Miraculous Medal

steps.title: Sign of the Cross
steps.versicle: In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit.

steps.title: Novena Intention
steps.prompt: Offer your intention to Our Lady of the Miraculous Medal, with confidence in her motherly aid.

steps.title: Versicle and response
steps.versicle: Pray for us, O Mother of the Miraculous Medal:
steps.response: That we may be made worthy of the promises of Christ.

mm_invocation.text: O Mary, conceived without sin, pray for us who have recourse to Thee.

hail_mary.text:
Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee.
Blessed art thou among women,
and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus.
Holy Mary, Mother of God,
pray for us sinners,
now and at the hour of our death.
Amen.
hail_mary.latin:
Ave Maria, gratia plena, Dominus tecum.
Benedicta tu in mulieribus,
et benedictus fructus ventris tui, Iesus.
Sancta Maria, Mater Dei,
ora pro nobis peccatoribus,
nunc et in hora mortis nostrae.
Amen.

mm_daily_prayer.text: O Holy Virgin Mary, who didst promise signal graces to those who wear thy Medal with faith: in these nine days before thy feast, keep me in constant recourse to thee, and let thy motherly intercession obtain from thine only-begotten Son the graces I ask. Amen.

schedule_note.note: The nine days before the November 27 feast of Our Lady of the Miraculous Medal (the window completes on the feast, which is not due). The shrines' weekly perpetual novenas (Mondays at the Philadelphia Basilica since 1930; Tuesdays at many parishes) are a separate practice documented here, not this pack's schedule; the Association of the Miraculous Medal's novena booklet is copyrighted, so the session is a single static session of public-domain formulas plus short original invocations.
